participation.context: Read standing, tapped four beats, and bought nothing.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Came to his own door and would not have the book worn out.
participation.name: John Harrison

relations.note: the stall by his shop, the book unbought
relations.quote: You may read it, Master Shakespeare, but you may not wear it out.

story.body: Two shillings was too dear in Lent. You read the first book under the cloister and put the quarto back. Harrison came out of the White Greyhound and said, "You may read it, Master Shakespeare, but you may not wear it out." You did not buy it.

relations.note: the stall by his shop, the book unbought
relations.quote: You may read it, Master Shakespeare, but you may not wear it out.

title: Read the first book of Daniel standing

relations.note: the book left at the stall

story.body: You noted the captive ride, the woman at the window, and the chronicle's girl of ten. You wrote the price and that you did not pay it. You did not open a heading for a king, and you did not write a speech for Verona.

relations.note: the book left at the stall

title: Noted that Daniel's queen is a woman
